plugins.name: evolvepreneuriq-console
plugins.description: Evolvepreneur®iQ Workplace (v0.3.0) — a white-label, connector-driven AI operator console. Two-panel dashboard: Workflows (incl. a Business Brain lane and a Train & Improve lane that turns your edits into permanent improvements), Cowork Skills, all EIQ Connector tools, and the EIQ persona library — personalised per client, with dark mode, safe-by-default guardrails, an in-dashboard update check, and first-run setup for standing automations.
